summary: {clerk} serves the whole chamber on the floor but only one party in its closed meetings.
realLife: Swanson recalled serving the Republican minority's caucus while the other reading clerk covered the Democratic side.
gates: The chamber assigns separate clerks to the parties for closed caucus business.
inGame: needs: the party assignments and whether the meeting is closed.

turns.what: The caucus sends its papers to that clerk.
turns.writesBack: The closed meeting has a reader.

turns.pulledBy: The only available reader serves the other caucus.
turns.what: The caucus chair looks for a substitute.
turns.writesBack: The papers stay with the caucus.
